fields.Name: MJ Canon
fields.Description: Curated graph over MemberJunction's canon: entities, fields, alternate base views, queries and the governed concepts they define, measure or describe. Its structural edges come from metadata providers; its concept edges are stored and reviewed.

fields.Name: Entity Metadata
fields.Description: References (foreign keys), Is A (IS-A parents) and Field Of edges projected from loaded entity metadata, with no database queries.

fields.Name: Query Metadata
fields.Description: Reads (query to entity or alternate base view) and Composes (query to query) edges projected from the cached query catalog, with no database queries.

fields.Name: Alternate Base Views
fields.Description: Subsets edges from each alternate base view to the entity (and parent view) whose rows it narrows.
